## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-fascicle Latter-Qín 後秦 translation of the *Aṣṭasāhasrikā Prajñāpāramitā* by Kumārajīva. The title's 小品 ("small-section") distinguishes the 8,000-verse *Aṣṭasāhasrikā* from the 25,000-verse 大品 *Pañcaviṃśatisāhasrikā* (= [T223](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0004)). The Taishō header cross-references the canon's *Aṣṭasāhasrikā* parallels.

**Abstract**

T227 is the principal pre-Xuánzàng Chinese translation of the *Aṣṭasāhasrikā* and was the standard text of that *sūtra* in East-Asian Buddhism throughout the medieval period. The translation is dated by the *Chū sānzàng jì jí* to Hóngshǐ 弘始 10 = 408 CE at Cháng'ān, with [僧叡](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E5%8F%A1) Sēngruì as principal editor. T227 displaced the earlier [T224](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0010), [T225](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0011), and [T226](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6c/KR6c0012) as the standard *Aṣṭasāhasrikā* lexicon in Chinese Mahāyāna doctrinal literature.
